vr_only.en: Monkey Tag is played in a VR headset: come back in VR!

st_run.en: Run from the lava! Monkeys left: {0}

st_over.ru: Все в лаве! Скоро новый раунд

st_screen.en: Looking around on a screen: walk as usual (this game is for VR)

hint.en: No legs, just arms: slap the ground and push to jump, pull on walls and trees to climb, let go to fly
